name: updated-at-field-omitted-on-replace
$comment: Server-stamped updatedAtField (FM-36) replace-omission: a replace may omit the updatedAtField field even though replace normally requires every non-optional field — the stamp supplies it before validation (insert and replace share the omission ruling; a supplied value is overwritten). Determinism: the follow-up read filters updatedAt > 0, matching only a server-stamped epoch-ms value; the generated stamp is normalized out of the expected doc.
